note: Village of Ayr park (state SRA until May 2011; Little Blue NRD assists) 2 mi N and 1/2 mi W of Ayr, beside the Little Blue River, on a 5-acre lake; gravel access. 46 electric sites plus 50 non-designated sites in loops south of the lake; vault toilets, water hydrants, swim beach, shelters, playground, tennis court. Pay by envelope on site; dump station by the fire station in Ayr (fee). --Claude
summary: Not a state SRA since May 4, 2011 - the Village of Ayr owns it, Little Blue NRD assists (ownership state -> local). NRD page: 46 electric + 50 non-designated sites (count 72 -> 96; stored 22 electric / 20-30 A unsupported, amperage cleared). Fees $7/$20 (2021 sheet). FCFS, 14-day limit. Lake is officially 5 acres (imagery ~5-6) and the camp road runs between it and every site: lakefront -> lakeview. Phone (402) 463-8880.
flags: OWNERSHIP state -> local: Little Blue NRD page: 'As of May 4, 2011 the area was transferred from the Nebraska Game and Parks Commission to the Village of Ayr. The Little Blue NRD is providing assistance to the Village in various management aspects.' Stops inheriting the state:NE policy (RA booking, $8.50 reservation fee, park entry permit - the note's 'State park entry permit required' is gone). Rename to 'Crystal Lake Recreation Area' (the NRD's and the map's name).

WEBSITE https://outdoornebraska.gov/location/crystal-lake/ is NGPC's (not the operator since 2011; blocked, unread) -> https://littlebluenrd.org/recreation/ (Crystal Lake section). PHONE missing -> (402) 463-8880 (the NRD page's contact for the area). apply.py writes neither.

WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview. The NRD calls it 'a five acre lake'; imagery measures a strip ~340 m long by 50-80 m wide (~5-6 acres), right at the pond line. The park road follows the south shore ~15-30 m from the water, and the map's camper loops (with the hookup and hydrant symbols) lie south of that road, ~40-200 m from the water; the lakeside strip holds the swim beach, beach house, fishing dock and shelters (day use). Road and day use between every site and the water = *view at best. If AWH reads 5 acres as a pond, it goes to not waterfront instead.

SITES: count 96 = 46 electric + 50 'non-designated' (NRD page). The NRD's older map (uploaded 2018/04) shows only '6 Individual Elec. Hookups, 2 Group Elec. Hookups' and a 'Primitive Group Camping' area, so the 46 may count pedestals differently; amperage unstated anywhere (cleared).
FEES: $7 / $20 from the 2021 fee sheet (newest dated rate found); nightly_low 7 is the non-electric pad, which a 23-ft rig can use (rules: 'Please do NOT drive on the grass').
PIN 40.4563,-98.4385 is on the lakeside road at the south shore, ~40-100 m from the camper loops; under 250 m, no move.
SAND: not applicable (gravel roads). FIT: no posted limit; loops are open gravel.
